/live/archive/ has no heading saying "Live archive". Its empty state tells the owner to run a node command, which is agent wording, not owner wording (content).

Pre-existing chrome: the drawer rail buttons wrap to 3.2 lines at 400 (layout.json wraps drawer-rail-ai/drawer-rail-menu). The feed column runs 483px wide inside a wider grey column at 1200+, so the right half of the column is empty.

"In flight (18)" counts every session still marked active today and yesterday; 18 seems high, and some are probably stale "active" rows (requirements: the Now card must be kept current). shots/…-live/1200.png, top band.
Each Last landed date sits right-aligned on its own row under the title, which doubles the height of that group. shots/…-live/1200.png, middle band.

The Tasks tile has the same problem, but that tile was already there before this change.

"18 in flight" looks too high for one evening. LiveNow keeps any `active` session that has been quiet for less than 2 h, across two UTC days, so sessions that ended without closing still count. Check this against list_agents before trusting it. Evidence: layout.json widest_text_sample "Now · 18 in flight…".
